purpose: EmbeddingGemma 2の検索精度・根拠取得・速度の実測。小規模な合成データの検索結果として評価し、生成回答や一般性能と混同しない。

run_guardrails.preserve: 既存 localhost:8762 のCompose検索と nekoneko-embeddinggemma2_search_1。他のPodman接続・default・machine・containerは変更しない。

metrics.primary_quality_population: Test only: 57 answerable queries. Report the 3 unanswerable test cases separately. Dev is 14 answerable/1 unanswerable and can be used for pipeline checks or threshold selection before freezing the test.

ranking_units.asset_ranking: One item per asset_id, deduplicated to the highest-scoring result; k counts distinct assets.
ranking_units.chunk_ranking: One item per indexed source unit. Deduplicate identical normalized path+locator, keeping its highest-scoring result; distinct locators in one asset remain distinct; k counts distinct source units.
ranking_units.fine_evidence_basis: Structural only: asset_id/path plus the source locator and its coverage of gold evidence[]. Do not require text content or literal required_fact matches for the primary fine metric. An asset title/id with no specific locator is asset-level only.

locator_coverage.docx_pdf: Binary structural coverage: match the annotated page and, when gold specifies a heading/section, that same heading/section.
locator_coverage.spreadsheet: Expand each gold and result cell/range locator to its complete set of cell coordinates. For each evidence entry, compute covered_gold_cells / all_gold_cells using the union of top-k source-unit cells. Mere intersection is partial coverage, not a complete hit.
locator_coverage.presentation: Binary structural coverage: match the annotated slide number.
locator_coverage.audio_video: For each gold time interval, only segment-specific returned source-unit intervals no longer than the annotated gold interval may contribute. Compute the union length inside the gold interval divided by its full annotated duration. Mere overlap is partial coverage; a file/title-only result or an unsegmented whole-file envelope broader than the gold segment contributes zero fine coverage and remains asset-level only.
locator_coverage.entry_complete: An evidence[] entry is complete only at 100% structural coverage (floating-time comparison tolerance 1e-6 seconds). A query is complete only when every evidence[] entry is complete; NKB-070 requires four separate V-SAFE intervals.
locator_coverage.query_coverage: Average entry coverage within each query, then macro-average queries, so multi-evidence queries do not receive extra query weight.

primary_metrics.asset_hit_at_k: Fraction of answerable test queries with any gold asset among top k distinct assets.
primary_metrics.asset_mrr_at_10: Macro-average reciprocal rank of the first gold asset in top 10; zero if absent.
primary_metrics.fine_evidence_hit_at_k: Fraction of answerable test queries where the top-k chunk union fully covers at least one gold evidence[] entry.
primary_metrics.fine_evidence_mrr_at_10: Macro-average reciprocal rank of the first prefix of distinct chunks whose union completes any gold evidence[] entry; zero if none completes by rank 10.
primary_metrics.fine_evidence_coverage_at_k: Macro-average query coverage using the locator_coverage rules above.
primary_metrics.complete_evidence_at_k: Fraction of answerable test queries where every gold evidence[] entry reaches 100% locator coverage in top k.

secondary_precision_at_k.formula: Macro-average per-query relevant unique source units / min(k, unique units returned); k and dedup use the ranking_units definitions. No results yields N/A and is retained as a failed query.
secondary_precision_at_k.asset_level: An asset is relevant when its asset_id appears in any gold evidence entry.
secondary_precision_at_k.chunk_level: A chunk is structurally relevant if its specific source locator has valid granularity under locator_coverage and overlaps at least one gold evidence annotation. Report separately from full-coverage Hit@k and coverage metrics.
secondary_precision_at_k.interpretation: P@k is secondary to Hit@k/MRR@10 and does not represent answer correctness.

metrics.literal_fact_support_diagnostic: Compute normalized required_fact substring support only as a separately labeled lower-bound diagnostic. Missing text for native media is unknown for this diagnostic, not a failure or unknown for structural locator coverage.
metrics.answerability_and_calculation: Retrieval metrics do not score generated-answer correctness, calculation, or abstention. For 11 calculation tasks, finding source inputs is retrieval success, not computing the answer. Report 4 unanswerable queries separately; do not tune a threshold on test.

representation_and_limits.index_allowlist: Only multimodal-benchmark/inputs/** (14 files). Exclude gold, queries, benchmark, sources, QA, build scripts, prior results, COMPANY.md, and other files.
representation_and_limits.record: Preserve source asset_id/path/locator, indexed unit, and SHA-256 of the resulting index.
representation_and_limits.modality: Record whether each representation was native model input or derived text (OCR, ASR/transcript, sampled-frame description, extracted document/table/slide text, or metadata). Derived-text retrieval does not prove native multimodal support.
representation_and_limits.request: Send question text only; never send gold answers, required_facts, evidence, or test labels.
representation_and_limits.synthetic_limit: 14 self-authored fictional assets and 75 questions from one fictional company; results do not establish real-world or production accuracy. Only 4 questions are unanswerable (3 test, 1 dev), too few to establish a refusal threshold.
representation_and_limits.separate_baseline: Do not pool the prior 24-question text-only run with this 75-question run.

speed.measurement: CLI query path end-to-end: from question text entering query encoding through cosine scoring/ranking output; network time excluded. Keep model loading, input extraction, embedding/index build, and index write as separate timings.
speed.calls: Run the 60 frozen test queries in canonical order for 3 full repetitions (180 calls total); preserve query id, repetition, order, timing, and result for every call. No retries or silent omissions.
speed.first_query: Record the first chronological query call separately. Also report timing summaries across all 180 calls and warmed-only remaining 179 calls. If weights/model were already loaded for document indexing or smoke checks, call this the first query, not a cold model run.
speed.quality_repeat_rule: Calculate quality metrics per 60-query repetition. Use repetition 1 as the primary score and compare repetitions 2 and 3 for ranking/score consistency; do not treat 180 repeated calls as 180 independent questions.
speed.summary: count, median_ms, mean_ms, p95_ms (nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n)), max_ms, first_query_ms; all-call and warmed-only summaries.
speed.runtime_record: Resolved model revision; whether model/weights were cached or already warm; actual model input representation; device/dtype; package versions; CPU/GPU and thread count; container CPU/memory limits; vector dimension and index SHA-256; timer boundary and concurrency (serial).

post_run_checks: Verify model revision and frozen gold/query/input hashes.
Preserve lossless raw per-query rankings for all 180 calls, with repetition/order, asset ranking, chunk ranking, locators, representation provenance, and timings.
Independently recompute asset Hit@k/MRR@10, structural fine-evidence Hit@k/MRR@10, full locator coverage, complete evidence, secondary P@k, and latency summaries.
Compare indexed paths/locators with the 14-file allowlist; exclude gold/query/source/QA leakage.
Report literal fact support as a separate lower-bound diagnostic, never as generated-answer or numeric understanding accuracy.
Do not change questions, index boundaries, locator-coverage rules, or thresholds after viewing test scores; retain failed runs separately.

model_api_condition.text_query: Use SentenceTransformers encode_query(question, prompt_name="QuestionAnswering") for every QA benchmark query.
model_api_condition.media_document: For image/audio/video media-only document inputs, explicitly override text prompt with prompt="".
model_api_condition.text_document: For extracted text from a source file, use encode_document with an actual title derived from that source; preserve the exact title: text prefix used.
model_api_condition.selection_rule: This is the sole primary prompt condition for the frozen QA retrieval run. Do not select or change prompts after viewing test scores. A smoke check using another prompt is not the benchmark result.

annotation_validation.audio_asr: Not independently verified. Audio retrieval scores are retrieval against the frozen gold annotations/segments, not ASR correctness or answer understanding.

aggregation_helper_alignment.pre_evaluation_audit: Current helper makes literal normalized required_fact substring support a condition for fine evidence, classifies absent index text as unknown, accepts any temporal overlap, and treats cell-reference set intersection as a hit. These do not implement structural full-cell/full-interval coverage.
required_before_final_scoring: Use locator/path structure and full annotation coverage as the primary fine evidence score.
Report literal required_fact support separately as a lower-bound diagnostic; missing media text must not change primary structural coverage.
Compute cell-range and time-interval union coverage; partial overlap is not a complete evidence hit.
aggregation_helper_alignment.status: Mismatch identified before test scoring; independent result verification must not accept final helper scores until reconciled to this contract.
